name: La Jolla Community Center - American Mahjong
description: La Jolla Community Center class page quote: "This class will teach you the more advanced strategies of playing American Mahjong according to the NMJL Rules and Guidelines." and "This beginner-friendly evening course will teach you the fundamentals of the game, including tile recognition, the National Mah Jongg League card, game setup, strategy, and scoring." Beginner 6-week course (Carol Cohn; Oct 22-Dec 3 2026 session is sold out), evening beginner and intermediate classes (Grace Decker), plus Social Mahjong Tuesdays 10 AM-1 PM (free for members / $5 non-members; page does not say the social play is American).
address: 6811 La Jolla Blvd, La Jolla, San Diego, CA
